biggest_catch: This is a reimbursement, not a bonus: T-Mobile pays off your remaining phone balance (up to $800/line) — if you don't owe anything on your old phone, there's nothing to collect. And since July 9, 2026 it's open ONLY to brand-new customer accounts.
catches: You must actually owe a device balance or early termination fee — the card reimburses what you owe, up to $800/line; no balance means no payout.
Since July 9, 2026: brand-new customer accounts only. Existing T-Mobile customers are not eligible.
Your phone must have been on a device payment plan with your old carrier for at least 90 days, with at least three successful payments.

Port-in must be from an eligible carrier (AT&T, Verizon, etc.) — prepaid carriers, Metro, Google Voice, and T-Mobile-network MVNOs are excluded; no T-Mobile service on that number in the past 90 days.
Submit proof of your balance at promotions.t-mobile.com within 30 days of port-in.
The payout is a virtual prepaid Mastercard: no cash access, expires in 6 months.

c1.evidence: T-Mobile is a real operating carrier; the Keep and Switch program is documented on t-mobile.com support.

c2.evidence: Official T-Mobile Keep and Switch support page states: reimbursement of the previous carrier's remaining device payment balance, up to $800 per line via virtual prepaid Mastercard (max 4 per account); open only to brand-new accounts since July 9, 2026.

c3.evidence: No enrollment fee; you pay for the new T-Mobile line's service.

c4.evidence: Official page states the card typically arrives within 15 days after the rebate submission is approved.

eligibility: Brand-new T-Mobile customer account (existing accounts excluded since July 9, 2026). Port a number from an eligible carrier (AT&T/Verizon/etc.; excludes prepaid, Metro, Google Voice, T-Mobile-network MVNOs; no T-Mobile use of that number in 90 days). Bring an eligible phone that has been on a device payment plan with the old carrier for 90+ days with 3+ payments. Submit proof within 30 days.
notes: Verified from the official T-Mobile Keep and Switch support page on 2026-09-23. Framed honestly as a device-balance reimbursement (found money only if you owe a balance), not a sign-up bonus. The virtual card is spendable but not cash. payout_quote: We'll reimburse your previous carrier's remaining device payment balance, up to $800 per line via virtual prepaid Mastercard (max 4 per account), when you activate a new voice line and port in from an eligible carrier. Starting July 9, 2026, open only to brand-new customer accounts.

s2.note: Reimbursement only — no owed balance means no payout; virtual card, no cash access, 6-month expiry — all disclosed.

steps: Check you qualify: brand-new to T-Mobile, porting from an eligible carrier, and you still owe a balance on your old phone (on a payment plan for 90+ days with 3+ payments made).
Activate a new T-Mobile voice line and port your number in; unlock your device before porting out.
Complete activation and port-in with your new phone first.
Within 30 days, go to promotions.t-mobile.com, log in with your T-Mobile ID, select Keep and Switch, and upload a PDF of your most recent bill/financing details showing the payoff amount.
Once approved, your virtual prepaid Mastercard (up to $800/line, max 4 lines) arrives — typically within 15 days. Use it online or via mobile payment apps before it expires in 6 months.
timing: Card typically arrives within 15 days after the reimbursement submission is approved.
